observed_capabilities: Truth Oracle evidence classification and verification substrate
Gauntlet candidate validation and paid TollRoad access
customer_problem: The strongest observed zero-human customer service is supplier quote comparison: a buyer already holding 2-5 quotes needs a normalized decision packet.
existing_payment_path: QUOTE-COMPARE-49 is published at NZ$49 with an existing Stripe payment link and Stripe price/payment-link identifiers in public/catalog.json.
existing_entitlement_path: The quote-intake Edge Function requires a live paid Stripe checkout session, exact payment link, SKU, revenue_orders row, revenue_entitlements row and fulfillment_requests row before intake.
existing_service_wall: Supabase quote-intake v2 is the existing wall. It rejects unpaid/test/wrong-link/wrong-SKU sessions and missing canonical settlement or entitlement records before issuing signed upload URLs.
existing_fulfillment: Supabase quote-fulfillment v2 extracts PDF/CSV/JSON/Markdown inputs, normalizes supplier/total/MOQ/lead-time/payment terms, creates HTML and CSV artifacts, updates fulfillment state and marks the entitlement fulfilled.
existing_delivery: Signed storage download URL is generated by the quote-intake status action after fulfilled state.
existing_evidence: Input SHA-256 values, fulfillment reference, evidence reference and fulfillment state are persisted. The worker explicitly returns revenue_claimed=false and external_action_performed=false.
current_blocker: Before this audit there was no observed public quote-comparison post-payment input page in the repository. The automated backend path already existed.
smallest_change: Add one static quote-comparison input page that calls the existing quote-intake wall, uploads to the existing private fulfillment bucket, finalizes the existing fulfillment request and exposes the existing signed delivery URL.
production_proof: Supabase reports quote-intake v2 and quote-fulfillment v2 ACTIVE. The repository contains the published QUOTE-COMPARE-49 catalog entry and zero-human fulfillment registry entry. A real external paid transaction was not observed, so economic truth remains unchanged.
explicit_unknowns: No real external buyer/payment/fulfillment transaction was exercised in this audit.
